[F007] All 49 tests pass. The fix is complete and in scope.

## Summary

This was a re-dispatch of F007 after the no-progress breaker. Per **D035**, F007 was split: the codex auditor's three remaining findings were triaged so that only finding #1 (AC7e) stays in F007's scope, while findings #2 (live-path completeness) and #3 (ActionItem `feature_id` uniqueness) were relocated to a new dependent feature (F007b/F012) and are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE. I fixed the one in-scope defect: the `stale_onboarding` branch of `build_setup_choices` was emitting a bare `dontpanic projects add <name> <path> --onboard`, which `projects_registry.add_project` (projects_registry.py:211-215) refuses for an already-registered project — so it would never run. It now emits the validated `--onboard --force --yes` re-add form (matching the existing doctor remediation), with a comment and rationale explaining why, while the first-time `missing_project` path correctly keeps the bare `--onboard`. I strengthened the test suite with `test_stale_onboarding_already_registered_emits_force_yes`, which asserts AC7e directly (force/yes for re-onboarding, bare `--onboard` for fresh registration). The targeted run of `test_operations_guidance_f007.py` and `test_signed_off_finalizer.py` is green (49 passed).

$ PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_operations_guidance_f007.py scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_signed_off_finalizer.py -q -p no:cac
